summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Vale S.A. announcing the dates for its 2Q26 earnings releases and conference call. The disclosure simply provides the schedule for the production and sales report (July 21, 2026), the financial performance report (July 30, 2026), and the subsequent webcast. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is referenced. The filing contains no deal terms or structural changes, and the content is purely an earnings calendar reminder. A foreign private issuer report of this nature does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
